descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nHP와 MP를 소모하여 장착 중인 폴암의 공격 속도를 일시적으로 증가시킨다. 폴암을 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c폴암 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Polearm Booster

description.name: Iron Will

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nRushes forward a certain distance in the direction you are facing. description.name: Max MP Increase

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nReplaces a portion of damage taken with MP instead of HP. If MP reaches 0, all damage is taken as HP. Press the key again to deactivate the effect.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nSustituye parte del daño recibido por MP en vez de HP. Si los MP llegan a 0, todo el daño se recibe como HP. Presiona la tecla otra vez para desactivar el efecto.

description.name: Magic Guard

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily increases Weapon Def. and Magic Def. by concentrating magic into your armor.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Magic Guard#

description.name: Energy Bolt

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to attack a single enemy within 300 range in front twice. The higher the Mastery, the lower the damage variation.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 1 Energy Bolt#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nAttacks surrounding monsters with a thunderbolt, dealing lightning-elemental damage. All monsters, except those resistant to lightning, have a chance to be stunned by electrocution.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAtaca a los monstruos cercanos con un rayo e inflige daño de rayo. Todos los monstruos, excepto los resistentes al rayo, pueden quedar aturdidos por electrocución.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n주변의 몬스터를 번개로 공격하여 번개 속성 데미지를 입힌다. 번개 속성에 내성이 있는 몬스터를 제외한 모든 몬스터는 일정 확률로 감전되어 기절한다.

description.name: Thunder Bolt

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nAbsorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy's MP is 0.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nAbsorbs the enemy's MP when attacking with Magic skills, but only once every 5 seconds. Cannot absorb if the enemy's MP is 0.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAbsorbe los MP del enemigo al atacar con habilidades mágicas, pero solo una vez cada 5 segundos. No puede absorber si los MP del enemigo son 0.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n마법 공격 시 적의 MP를 흡수하지만, 5초에 한 번만 흡수할 수 있다. 적의 MP가 0일 경우에는 흡수할 수 없다.

description.name: MP Eater

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nUse the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nUse the arrow keys to teleport a set distance within the same map.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nUsa las teclas de dirección para teletransportarte una distancia fija dentro del mismo mapa.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n방향키를 사용하여 같은 맵 안의 일정 거리를 텔레포트한다.

description.name: Teleport

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nRecovers the HP of all party members around the area. The amount of healing depends on the number of people being healed, and undead monsters around the area will receive damage.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nRecovers the HP of all party members around the area. The amount of healing depends on the number of people being healed, and undead monsters around the area will receive damage.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nRecupera los HP de todos los miembros del grupo cercanos. La cantidad de curación depende del número de personas curadas, y los monstruos no muertos cercanos reciben daño.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n주변에 있는 모든 파티원의 HP를 회복시킨다. 회복시키는 인원수에 따라 회복량이 달라지며, 주변에 있는 언데드 몬스터는 피해를 입는다.

description.name: Heal

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nReduces physical damage taken for a certain duration, and deals non-elemental magic damage to any monster that takes contact damage from the caster.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Heal#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nReduces physical damage taken for a certain duration, and deals non-elemental magic damage to any monster that takes contact damage from the caster.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Heal#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nReduce el daño físico recibido durante cierto tiempo e inflige daño mágico no elemental a cualquier monstruo que reciba daño por contacto del lanzador.\nHabilidad requerida: #cCuración de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일정 시간 동안 받는 물리 피해를 감소시키고, 시전자와 접촉하여 데미지를 받는 몬스터에게 무속성 마법 데미지를 준다.\n필요 스킬 : #c힐 5레벨 이상#

description.name: Invincible

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily reduces all Damage taken and increases the HP recovery from the Heal skill for all nearby party members.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Invincible#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily reduces all Damage taken and increases the HP recovery from the Heal skill for all nearby party members.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Invincible#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nReduce temporalmente todo el daño recibido y aumenta la recuperación de HP de la habilidad Curación para todos los miembros cercanos del grupo.\nHabilidad requerida: #cInvencible de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일정 시간 동안 받는 모든 피해를 감소시키고 주변 파티원 모두의 힐 스킬 HP 회복량을 증가시킨다.\n필요 스킬 : #c인빈서블 5레벨 이상#

description.name: Bless

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nAttacks a monster by firing a holy arrow. Very effective against the undead or devil-based monsters.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nAttacks a monster by firing a holy arrow. Very effective against the undead or devil-based monsters.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nDispara una flecha sagrada a un monstruo. Muy efectiva contra monstruos no muertos o demoníacos.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n성스러운 화살을 발사하여 몬스터를 공격한다. 언데드 또는 악마 계열 몬스터에게 매우 효과적이다.

description.name: Holy Arrow

description.desc: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nAumenta el Critical Rate y el Critical Damage.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 15]\nCritical Rate와 Critical Damage가 증가한다.

description.name: Critical Shot

description.desc: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases attack range for bows and crossbows.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases attack range for bows and crossbows.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nAumenta el alcance de ataque de arcos y ballestas.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 15]\nbow와 석궁의 사거리를 증가시킨다.

description.name: The Eye of Amazon

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nFocus to temporarily increase Accuracy and Evasion.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 The Eye of Amazon#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nFocus to temporarily increase Accuracy and Evasion.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 The Eye of Amazon#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConcéntrate para aumentar temporalmente Accuracy y Evasion.\nHabilidad requerida: #cEl ojo de las Amazonas de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n집중하여 일정 시간 동안 Accuracy와 Evasion을 증가시킨다.\n필요 스킬: #c아마존의 눈 3레벨 이상#

description.name: Focus

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nFires an arrow with power at a single enemy within 350 range in front. Deals more damage than usual.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nFires an arrow with power at a single enemy within 350 range in front. Deals more damage than usual.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nDispara una flecha poderosa a un solo enemigo a 350 de alcance al frente. Inflige más daño de lo normal.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n전방 350 범위 내의 적 하나에게 힘껏 화살을 발사한다. 일반적인 경우보다 더 큰 데미지를 준다.

description.name: Arrow Blow

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes 2 arrows to attack up to 2 enemies within 300 range in front.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 1 Arrow Blow#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes 2 arrows to attack up to 2 enemies within 300 range in front.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 1 Arrow Blow#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume 2 flechas para atacar hasta 2 enemigos a 300 de alcance al frente.\nHabilidad requerida: #cGolpe de flecha de nivel 1 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n화살 2개를 소모하여 전방 300 범위 내의 적 최대 2명을 공격한다.\n필요 스킬: #c애로우 블로우 1레벨 이상#

description.name: Double Shot

description.desc: [Master Level: 15]\nSwings the bow widely to push multiple enemies far back. This attack always hits as a critical, and as the level rises, the number of monsters that one can push back with one swing increases.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nSwings the bow widely to push multiple enemies far back. This attack always hits as a critical, and as the level rises, the number of monsters that one can push back with one swing increases.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nDa un golpe amplio con el arco para empujar a varios enemigos. Este ataque siempre es crítico y, a medida que sube el nivel, aumenta la cantidad de monstruos que puede empujar de un golpe.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 15]\n활을 크게 휘둘러 다수의 적을 멀리 밀어낸다. 반드시 Critical로 명중하며, 레벨이 높아질수록 한 번에 밀어낼 수 있는 몬스터의 수가 늘어난다.

description.name: Power Knockback

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Bow Mastery, Critical Rate, and Movement Speed. This effect only applies when a bow is equipped.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Bow Mastery, Critical Rate, and Movement Speed. This effect only applies when a bow is equipped.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta Maestría con arco, Critical Rate y Speed. Este efecto solo se aplica al equipar un arco.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n보우 마스터리, Critical Rate 및 Speed를 증가시킨다. 활을 장착한 경우에만 이 효과가 적용된다.

description.name: Bow Mastery

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nCritical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Bow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nCritical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Bow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nLos golpes críticos cortan los tendones del enemigo y lo ralentizan.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con arco de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nCritical 공격이 적의 힘줄을 끊어 Speed를 느리게 한다.\n필요 스킬 : #c보우 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Amazon's Judgement

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nUsing attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to up to 3 enemies in front. Only applies when equipped with a bow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Bow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nUsing attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to up to 3 enemies in front. Only applies when equipped with a bow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Bow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAl usar habilidades de ataque, hay una probabilidad de activar la habilidad Ataque final durante 60 s. Mientras esté activa, puedes usarla para infligir mucho daño a hasta 3 enemigos frente a ti. Solo se aplica al equipar un arco.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con arco de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n공격 스킬을 사용하면 60초 동안 일정 확률로 파이널 어택 스킬을 활성화한다. 활성화된 동안 스킬을 사용할 수 있으며, 전방의 최대 3명의 적에게 큰 데미지를 준다. 활을 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c보우 마스터리 레벨 3 이상#

description.name: Final Attack: Bow

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped bow. Only applies when equipped with a bow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Bow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped bow. Only applies when equipped with a bow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Bow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume HP y MP para aumentar temporalmente la velocidad de ataque del arco equipado. Solo se aplica con un arco equipado.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con arco de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nHP와 MP를 소모하여 장착한 활의 공격 속도를 일시적으로 증가시킨다. 활을 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c보우 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Bow Booster

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily allows the character to fire bow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a bow equipped.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Bow Booster#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily allows the character to fire bow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a bow equipped.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Bow Booster#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nPermite temporalmente disparar flechas sin consumirlas. Solo funciona con un arco equipado.\nHabilidad requerida: #cPotenciador de arco de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일시적으로 화살을 소모하지 않고 활로 화살을 발사할 수 있게 한다. 활을 장착한 경우에만 작동한다.\n필요 스킬: #c보우 부스터 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Soul Arrow: Bow

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nFires an arrow with a bomb attached to it. If struck cleanly, the bomb explodes on the enemy, stunning some enemies around with a certain trigger rate. Can't attack more than 6 at once, and it only works with a bow equipped.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nFires an arrow with a bomb attached to it. If struck cleanly, the bomb explodes on the enemy, stunning some enemies around with a certain trigger rate. Can't attack more than 6 at once, and it only works with a bow equipped.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nDispara una flecha con una bomba adherida. Si impacta de lleno, la bomba explota sobre el enemigo y aturde a algunos enemigos cercanos con cierta probabilidad. No puede atacar a más de 6 a la vez y solo funciona con un arco equipado.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n폭탄을 부착한 화살을 발사한다. 정확히 명중하면 일정 확률로 폭탄이 적에게서 폭발하여 주변의 일부 적을 기절시킨다. 한 번에 6명보다 많이 공격할 수 없으며, 활을 장착한 경우에만 작동한다.

description.name: Arrow Bomb

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Crossbow Mastery and Critical Damage. It only applies when a crossbow is equipped.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Crossbow Mastery and Critical Damage. It only applies when a crossbow is equipped.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta la Maestría con ballesta y el Critical Damage. Solo se aplica al equipar una ballesta.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n석궁 마스터리와 Critical Damage를 증가시킨다. 석궁을 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.

description.name: Crossbow Mastery

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nCritical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nCritical hits sever the enemy's tendons, slowing them down.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nLos golpes críticos cortan los tendones del enemigo y lo ralentizan.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con ballesta de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nCritical 공격 시 적의 힘줄을 끊어 적을 느리게 만든다.\n필요 스킬 : #c크로스보우 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Amazon's Judgement

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nUsing attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy. Only applies when equipped with a crossbow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Crossbow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nUsing attack skills has a chance to enable the Final Attack skill for 60 sec. While enabled, the skill can be used, dealing heavy damage to a single enemy. Only applies when equipped with a crossbow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Crossbow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAl usar habilidades de ataque, hay una probabilidad de activar la habilidad Ataque final durante 60 s. Mientras esté activa, puedes usarla para infligir mucho daño a un solo enemigo. Solo se aplica al equipar una ballesta.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con ballesta de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n공격 스킬을 사용하면 60초 동안 파이널 어택 스킬을 활성화할 확률이 있다. 활성화된 동안 해당 스킬을 사용하여 단일 적에게 큰 데미지를 준다. 크로스보우를 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c크로스보우 마스터리 레벨 3 이상#

description.name: Final Attack: Crossbow

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped crossbow. Only applies when equipped with a crossbow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped crossbow. Only applies when equipped with a crossbow.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume HP y MP para aumentar temporalmente la velocidad de ataque de la ballesta equipada. Solo se aplica al equipar una ballesta.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con ballesta de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n장착한 크로스보우의 공격 속도를 일시적으로 높이기 위해 HP와 MP를 소모한다. 크로스보우를 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.  \n필요 스킬: #c크로스보우 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Crossbow Booster

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily allows the character to fire crossbow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a crossbow equipped.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Booster#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily allows the character to fire crossbow arrows without using up arrows. Only works with a crossbow equipped.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Crossbow Booster#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nPermite temporalmente disparar flechas de ballesta sin gastar flechas. Solo funciona con una ballesta equipada.\nHabilidad requerida: #cPotenciador de ballesta de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일시적으로 화살을 소모하지 않고 크로스보우 화살을 발사할 수 있게 한다. 크로스보우를 장착한 경우에만 작동한다.\n필요 스킬: #c크로스보우 부스터 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Soul Arrow: Crossbow

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nAttacks up to 6 monsters at once with a powerful arrow, which penetrates through them. Damage decreases as the arrow flies through each monster.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nAttacks up to 6 monsters at once with a powerful arrow, which penetrates through them. Damage decreases as the arrow flies through each monster.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAtaca hasta a 6 monstruos a la vez con una poderosa flecha que los atraviesa. El daño disminuye a medida que la flecha atraviesa a cada monstruo.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n강력한 화살로 최대 6마리의 몬스터를 동시에 공격하며, 화살은 몬스터들을 관통한다. 화살이 각 몬스터를 관통할 때마다 데미지가 감소한다.

description.name: Iron Arrow

description.desc: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases Accuracy and Evasion.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases Accuracy and Evasion.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nAumenta la Accuracy y la Evasion.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 15]\nAccuracy과 Evasion을 증가시킨다.

description.name: Nimble Body

description.desc: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases attack range for throwing weapons such as Throwing Stars and Knives.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 on Nimble Body#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 15]\nIncreases attack range for throwing weapons such as Throwing Stars and Knives.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 on Nimble Body#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 15]\nAumenta el alcance de ataque de armas arrojadizas como Estrellas arrojadizas y Cuchillos.\nHabilidad requerida: #cCuerpo ágil de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 15]\nThrowing Stars 및 Knives 같은 투척 무기의 사정거리를 증가시킨다.\n필요 스킬 : #c님블바디 3레벨 이상#

description.name: Keen Eyes

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily decreases the Attack Power and Weapon Def. of an enemy and dissuades it from attacking you. Has no effect on a monster that's already in "Disorder."

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily decreases the Attack Power and Weapon Def. of an enemy and dissuades it from attacking you. Has no effect on a monster that's already in "Disorder."
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nReduce temporalmente el Attack Power y la Weapon Def. de un enemigo, y lo disuade de atacarte. No afecta a monstruos que ya estén en "Desorden."
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일정 시간 동안 적의 Attack Power와 Weapon Def.을 감소시키며 자신을 공격하지 못하도록 한다. 이미 "디스오더" 상태에 있는 몬스터에게는 효과가 없다.

description.name: Disorder

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to hide in the shadows. Cannot be attacked and cannot attack while hidden. Press the key again to deactivate the effect.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Disorder#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to hide in the shadows. Cannot be attacked and cannot attack while hidden. Press the key again to deactivate the effect.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Disorder#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume MP para ocultarte en las sombras. Mientras permanezcas en ellas, nadie podrá atacarte y tú tampoco podrás atacar Presiona la tecla otra vez para desactivar el efecto.\nHabilidad requerida: #cDesorden de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nMP를 소모하여 그림자 속에 숨는다. 숨은 동안에는 공격받지도 공격할 수도 없다. 키를 다시 누르면 효과가 해제된다.\n필요 스킬: #c디스오더 레벨 3 이상#

description.name: Dark Sight

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to quickly stab a monster twice using a dagger.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to quickly stab a monster twice using a dagger.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume MP para apuñalar rápidamente dos veces a un monstruo con una daga.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nMP를 소모하여 단검으로 몬스터 한 마리를 빠르게 두 번 찌른다.

description.name: Double Stab

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to throw 2 throwing stars at a single enemy within 200 range in front, dealing powerful damage based on LUK. Attacks based on LUK regardless of Claw Mastery.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes MP to throw 2 throwing stars at a single enemy within 200 range in front, dealing powerful damage based on LUK. Attacks based on LUK regardless of Claw Mastery.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume MP para lanzar 2 estrellas arrojadizas a un solo enemigo a una distancia de hasta 200 al frente e infligir mucho daño según LUK. Ataca según LUK sin importar la Maestría con garra.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nMP를 소모하여 투척 표창 2개를 전방 200 범위 내의 적 한 명에게 던져 LUK에 기반한 큰 데미지를 준다. 클로 마스터리와 관계없이 LUK에 기반하여 공격한다.

description.name: Lucky Seven

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Claw Mastery and Attack Power, and gives a chance to recover used throwing stars when using throwing star attacks. Only applies when a claw is equipped.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Claw Mastery and Attack Power, and gives a chance to recover used throwing stars when using throwing star attacks. Only applies when a claw is equipped.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta maestría con garra y Attack Power, y otorga una probabilidad de recuperar estrellas arrojadizas usadas al atacar con ellas. Solo se aplica al equipar una garra.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n클로 마스터리와 Attack Power를 증가시키며, 표창 공격 시 사용한 표창을 회수할 확률을 부여한다. 클로를 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.

description.name: Claw Mastery

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nIncreases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Claw Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nIncreases Critical Rate and Critical Damage.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 3 Claw Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAumenta Critical Rate y Critical Damage.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con garra de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\nCritical Rate와 Critical Damage를 증가시킨다.\n필요 스킬: #c클로 마스터리 레벨 3 이상#

description.name: Critical Throw

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nRecovers additional HP and MP with a certain chance when landing a critical hit. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nRecovers additional HP and MP with a certain chance when landing a critical hit. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAl asestar un golpe crítico, tienes cierta probabilidad de recuperar HP y MP adicionales. No puedes volver a recuperarlos durante 30 segundos.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nCritical 공격 시 일정 확률로 HP와 MP를 추가 회복한다. 단, 회복 후 30초 동안은 재회복 불가.

description.name: Critical Recovery

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped claw. Only applies when equipped with a claw.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Claw Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped claw. Only applies when equipped with a claw.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Claw Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume HP y MP para aumentar temporalmente la velocidad de ataque de la garra equipada. Solo se aplica al equipar una garra.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con garra de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nHP와 MP를 소모하여 장착한 클로의 공격 속도를 일시적으로 높인다. 클로를 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c클로 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Claw Booster

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta temporalmente la Speed y el Jump de todos los miembros del grupo cercanos.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일정 시간 동안 주변에 있는 모든 파티원의 speed와 jump를 증가시킨다.

description.name: Haste

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nAbsorbs some of the damage dealt to the enemy as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 3 Critical Recovery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nAbsorbs some of the damage dealt to the enemy as HP. The most one can absorb at once is 25% of the character's Max HP, and can't absorb more than the Max HP of the enemy.\nRequired Skill : #cAt least Level 3 Critical Recovery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nAbsorbe parte del daño infligido al enemigo como HP. Lo máximo que se puede absorber de una vez es el 25% de los HP máx. del personaje, y no puede absorber más que los HP máx. del enemigo.\nHabilidad requerida: #cRecuperación crítica de nivel 3 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n적에게 가한 데미지의 일부를 HP로 흡수한다. 한 번에 흡수할 수 있는 최대량은 캐릭터 최대 HP의 25%이며, 적의 최대 HP를 초과해 흡수할 수 없다.\n필요 스킬 : #c크리티컬 리커버리 레벨 3 이상#

description.name: Drain

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Dagger Mastery and Critical Rate, with a chance to ignore knockback effects. It only applies when a dagger is equipped.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nIncreases Dagger Mastery and Critical Rate, with a chance to ignore knockback effects. It only applies when a dagger is equipped.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta maestría con daga y Critical Rate, con una probabilidad de ignorar efectos de repulsión. Solo se aplica al equipar una daga.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n대거 마스터리와 Critical Rate를 증가시키며, 피격 시 넉백되지 않을 확률이 추가된다. 단검 장착 시에만 적용된다.

description.name: Dagger Mastery

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nRecover HP and MP with a certain chance when evading. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nRecover HP and MP with a certain chance when evading. Cannot recover again within 30 seconds after a recovery.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAl evadir, tienes cierta probabilidad de recuperar HP y MP. No puedes volver a recuperarlos durante 30 segundos.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n회피 성공 시 일정 확률로 HP와 MP를 회복한다. 단, 회복 성공 시 30초 동안은 재회복되지 않는다.

description.name: Nimble Recovery

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped dagger. Only applies when equipped with a dagger.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Dagger Mastery#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nConsumes HP and MP to temporarily increase the Attack Speed of the equipped dagger. Only applies when equipped with a dagger.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Dagger Mastery#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nConsume HP y MP para aumentar temporalmente la velocidad de ataque de la daga equipada. Solo se aplica con una daga equipada.\nHabilidad requerida: #cMaestría con daga de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\nHP와 MP를 소모하여 장착한 단검의 공격 속도를 일시적으로 높인다. 단검을 장착한 경우에만 적용된다.\n필요 스킬: #c대거 마스터리 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Dagger Booster

description.desc: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 20]\nTemporarily increases the speed and jump of all party members around the area.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 20]\nAumenta temporalmente la Speed y el Jump de todos los miembros del grupo cercanos.
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 20]\n일정 시간 동안 주변에 있는 모든 파티원의 speed와 jump를 증가시킨다.

description.name: Haste

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nAttempts to steal an item from up to 2 monsters at once with a given success rate. On a successful steal, stuns the enemies for 1.5 seconds and increases Attack Power for 60 seconds. Stealing works only once per monster and can be attempted until successful.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Haste#

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nAttempts to steal an item from up to 2 monsters at once with a given success rate. On a successful steal, stuns the enemies for 1.5 seconds and increases Attack Power for 60 seconds. Stealing works only once per monster and can be attempted until successful.\nRequired Skill: #cAt least Level 5 Haste#
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nIntenta robar un objeto de hasta 2 monstruos a la vez con cierta probabilidad de éxito. Al robar con éxito, aturde a los enemigos durante 1.5 s y aumenta Attack Power durante 60 s. Solo puedes robar una vez a cada monstruo y puedes intentarlo hasta tener éxito.\nHabilidad requerida: #cCeleridad de nivel 5 o superior#
descriptions.ko: [마스터 레벨: 30]\n일정한 성공 확률로 최대 2마리의 몬스터에게서 동시에 아이템을 훔치려고 한다. 훔치기에 성공하면 적을 1.5초 동안 기절시키고 Attack Power를 60초 동안 증가시킨다. 몬스터 한 마리당 한 번만 훔칠 수 있으며, 성공할 때까지 시도할 수 있다.\n필요 스킬: #c헤이스트 레벨 5 이상#

description.name: Steal

description.desc: [Master Level: 30]\nUse MP to attack an enemy up to 6 times in a row with a dagger.

descriptions.en: [Master Level: 30]\nUse MP to attack an enemy up to 6 times in a row with a dagger.
descriptions.es: [Nivel de maestría: 30]\nUsa MP para atacar a un enemigo hasta 6 veces seguidas con una daga.
descriptions.ko: [Master 레벨: 30]\nMP를 소비하여 단검으로 하나의 적을 최대 6번 연속 공격한다.
